data.fund_name: HDFC Gold ETF Fund of Fund
data.fund_type: An open ended Fund of Fund scheme investing in HDFC Gold ETF
data.investment_objective: To seek capital appreciation by investing in units of HDFC Gold ETF (HGETF). There is no assurance that the investment objectiveof the scheme will be achieved.
data.asset_allocation: Units of HDFC Gold ETF : 95% - 100 %; Debt securities and money market instruments : 0% - 5%
data.exit_load: In respect of each purchase/switch in of units- an Exit Load of 1% is payable if Units are redeemed/switched out within 15 daysfrom the date of allotment. No Exit Load is payable if Units are redeemed/switched-out on or after 15 days from the date ofallotment
